_comments._intro: Documentation-only map — every pipeline script reads specific keys and ignores _-prefixed ones.
_comments.servers: Official regional servers; jsonUrl = MainMenu.json on Kuro's website2.0 CDN (the pipeline's sole data source). CN is .com, the rest are .net — that is how Kuro serves them.
_comments.wallpapersBranch: Branch holding the flat mirror of all original images (desktop/ + mobile/).
_comments.previewBranch: Branch holding small JPEG previews plus the per-server HTML pages.
_comments.categoryBranches: Derived branches (one per category folder) powering the per-category one-click ZIPs; rebuilt each batch via git tree surgery from the wallpapers tip and force-pushed.
_comments.readme: README generation: main.outputPath/previewCount for the root file; server.outputDir/fields for the per-server pages on the preview branch.
_comments.website: Gallery site (docs/): filters = category filter chips; gallery.thumbnailSource/fallbackThumbnail = where card thumbnails come from.
_comments.release: Release notes: notesTemplate file + which metadata fields become table columns.
_comments.site: baseUrl = the gallery's public domain; used for the README web badge. Change domain here only.
_comments.worker: baseUrl = the random-wallpaper API's public domain (README section). Worker code itself is hostname-agnostic; only the generator reads this.
